meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tones ke liye aise sunscreens best hote hain jo lightweight hon, fast-absorb ho jayein, aur unka texture **gel, fluid, ya invisible/transparent** ho. Yeh formulas skin par koi white cast nahi chhodte aur oily ya combination skin par bhi chip-chip nahi karte.

Indian market mein kuch sabse behtareen options ye rahe:

### 1. Best Overall & Budget-Friendly

* **Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Gel (SPF 50 PA++++)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Ye ekdum paani jaisa lightweight gel hai. Lagate hi skin mein ghul jaata hai aur Hyaluronic Acid ki wajah se skin hydrated rehti hai. White cast ka koi sawaal hi nahi hai.
* **Aqualogica Glow+ Dewy Sunscreen (SPF 50 PA++++)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Water-lock technology par based hai. Ye skin par ek natural dewy (glass-skin jaisa) glow deta hai aur bilkul white cast nahi chhodta.

### 2. Best for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

* **Fixderma Shadow Gel SPF 50+**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Yeh non-greasy, non-sticky formula hai jo sensitive aur acne-prone skin ke liye dermatologist-recommended maana jaata hai. Yeh lagne ke baad bilkul gayab ho jaata hai.
* **Minimalist Invisible Sunscreen SPF 40 PA++++**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** Agar aapko ekdum matte aur zero-shine finish chahiye, toh yeh perfect hai. Ye silicone-based formula hai jo primer ki tarah kaam karta hai aur skin ko blur kar deta hai (zero white cast).

### 3. Best Premium Option

* **Isntree Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel (SPF 50+ PA++++)**
  *   * **Khasiyat:** K-Beauty (Korean) brand hai jo skincare lovers mein bahut popular hai. Yeh skincare serum jaisa lagta hai, skin ko deep hydration deta hai aur invisible finish deta hai.

---

### Sunscreen kharidte waqt in baaton ka dhyan rakhein:

* Hamesha **SPF 50 aur PA++++** wala sunscreen lein taaki aapko UV rays se maximum protection mile.
* Agar aapko bahut zyada paseena aata hai, toh **water-resistant** formula chunein.

Kya aapki skin type oily hai, dry hai, ya sensitive? Us hisab se main aapko ek exact product suggest kar sakoon.
